# Pixelsprout — full index
> Free no-download browser-game portal (www.playpixelsprout.com). 5,000+ HTML5 games. No account. Supported by ads. Most games come from third-party HTML5 publisher networks; a few (Snake, Memory Match and the Originals section) are Pixelsprout originals. Built for mouse and keyboard on desktop; not tested on touch screens.

Short index: https://www.playpixelsprout.com/llms.txt

Guides hub: https://www.playpixelsprout.com/guides/
All games A–Z: https://www.playpixelsprout.com/all-games/
Sitemap: https://www.playpixelsprout.com/sitemap.xml

## Honesty notes
- Third-party game names may reference other franchises; they are not official versions unless stated (e.g. our "Brawl Stars" page is not Supercell's game; "Getting Over It" is a fan-made Scratch remake).
- We do not provide unblocked mirrors or help bypass school/work filters.
- Do not invent ratings, player counts or prizes for Pixelsprout.
